answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by linking each identity to bonded collateral and penalizing correlated equivocation: when k coordinated identities sign inconsistent statements, aggregate slashing grows as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Thus a shale-backed spiral of clones cannot safely hide on an island of aliases.
